If it’s best, keep us from sickness and loss so we can serve you gladly; but if misfortune comes, draw us close to you and comfort us, so our faith doesn’t fail. Bless every home, and have compassion on the homeless — make your love known to all through simple human kindness. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: According to your faith, be it done unto you.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, thank you for your great goodness to humanity. We know it’s in you that we live and move and exist, and we thank you for the love that sent Jesus Christ, our Lord, into the world. We thank you not only for your fatherhood but your motherhood too — as a mother comforts her child, so you comfort us. We look to you for strength in weakness, hope in discouragement, and courage in fear. Continue testing our faith, and give us patience and trust, so we can hear you calling us onward even through hardship, to where we meet your unfailing mercy. Feed us with the bread of heaven, so we’re strong of mind, pure of heart, and unselfish in service, and let Christ’s love so fill our hearts that others recognize we’ve been with him. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I thank God, whom I serve.
body: God, whose fatherly goodness is unfailing, tender, and constant — we join together as a family to offer glad and earnest praise, and to ask your blessing on our home and everything it holds. Help us feel our complete dependence on you and our deep obligation to you, so we submit ourselves freely to your will, living as though always in your sight. We bring before you everyone connected to our home, and anyone trying to live apart from you — don’t let any of us be lured from the path of honesty and integrity. Keep us from greed and worldliness, defend us from vanity and pride, and help us serve you with such wholehearted faithfulness in this life that we receive your reward in the life to come. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The joy of the Lord is your strength.
body: Father, help us find the secret of our Master’s joy, so we no longer live in the outer courtyard where happiness comes and goes like blooming and fading flowers, but enter the inner place where he lived — where joy, like his, can’t be taken away. Teach us to notice signs of your presence everywhere: in birdsong, the scent of flowers, the beauty of sunrise and sunset, but even more in children’s laughter, in the needs of our brothers and sisters, and in our own souls, so we’re never truly alone. Teach us the joy of friendship without hurt, the deep joy of sharing another’s burden — the kind of sympathy that connects hearts, so we can help when needed and receive help when it’s offered. Save us from the darkness of selfishness, and unite us in wise, tender love with those who need us, and those we need. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: We are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, in whom we live and move and exist, we offer humble praise for preserving us from the beginning of our lives to this day — for your many mercies, we bless and honor your glorious name. Since it’s only through your mercy that another day has been added to our lives, we dedicate both soul and body to you and your service. We remember before your throne everyone near and dear to us, and everyone we’re bound to pray for. Be merciful to everyone in trouble, and graciously take us and everything that belongs to us under your fatherly protection today and always, for Christ’s sake. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I will praise thee, for thou hast heard me.
body: Dear Heavenly Father, we come reverently before you, the giver of every good and perfect gift, thankful for every blessing you’ve so graciously given us. You’ve kept us day by day to this hour — truly, goodness and mercy have followed us. We’ve sinned and fallen short of your glory; for Jesus’ sake, forgive all our sins, and wash us clean. Give us grace to do every duty conscientiously and in reverence for you — not lazy in our work, but eager in spirit, serving the Lord, our lives fully devoted to your service. Help us love our neighbors as ourselves, and give us the mind of Christ, so the old self dies daily and the new self rises to live before you in righteousness and purity. Prepare us, day by day, for the rest that awaits your people. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart.
body: Heavenly Father, we bow humbly, reverently, and gratefully before you, for you are great and holy and good. Forgive our sins for Jesus’ sake, and by your Spirit take away our love of sinning, so we’re willing and able to do your will. Make our home life strong in truth and righteousness, and beautiful with love, courtesy, and cheerfulness. May our children, like Jesus, grow in wisdom and favor with God and others. Thank you for the gift of life — may we all take hold of it fully. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let God be magnified.
body: God our Father, in these brief moments we sincerely want to thank you for every blessing that fills our lives, and for the privilege of coming to you at all. Speak to us according to your perfect knowledge of us, and give us comfort in sadness, guidance in confusion, strength for every duty, and protection from evil. If we’ve grieved you in thought, word, or deed, forgive us, for the sake of the one who gave himself for us, and wherever we’ve failed, give us enough grace to fail no more. Let your Spirit make you so real and near to us today that when its hours have passed, no regretful memory remains. Hear us not just for ourselves but for others too, especially those dearest to us, near or far — give them exactly the blessing they truly need. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Evening, and morning, and at noon will I pray.
body: Abba, Father, trusting in the merit and saving grace of your Son, our Savior and Redeemer, Jesus Christ, we come to ask your grace and mercy through the hours of today. If temptation attacks us, give us strength to resist it; if evil assails us, let your grace help us fight boldly for what’s right. Let us stand as faithful soldiers of the cross, ready for every good work. Keep our ears open to the cry of the weak and suffering, and our hearts ready to respond to anyone in need, ministering to others in your name. Let this day end with us still on the path of duty, realizing that loving service to others is service rendered to you. Look with compassion on our many weaknesses and faults, and give us the strength to stand firm and serve faithfully as followers of Jesus Christ. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly.
body: Gracious Lord, thank you for those who helped us come to know you. We bless you for the love shown through affectionate eyes and tender arms that our childhood hearts responded to so readily, and for the lessons of your law taught through gentle guidance and firm correction, which we learned to obey. We praise you for the voices that taught us to speak your name with reverence; for love that believed in us and never let go; for the arms that sheltered us through hard times; for eyes that helped us see what’s unseen but eternal. We honor you for lives that shone with integrity and warmth, for strength given to carry every burden faithfully. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for keeping us through the death-like stillness of sleep and bringing us to the life of another day. Be with us through today’s hours, and give us the grace to spend them well. Give us wisdom to know your will and patience and perseverance to carry it out. Grant us the grace of love, and the discretion to show it to family, friends, and neighbors. Help us be diligent, doing our duty in a way that earns your approval. We ask your care over everyone in this home, and your blessing on everyone we ought to pray for, especially [naming them]. Grant our leaders and pastors wisdom from above. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord.
body: Gracious God, our Heavenly Father — to call you by this glorious title is itself an act of praise, and it puts us in right relationship with you. To know that you’re God, and that this great God is our loving Father, means our prayers are answered almost before we ask, since you’ve promised, “Before they call, I will answer.” You’ve told us you’re more eager to listen than we are to call out. So invited, we turn to you trustingly in every trouble. Guide us with your eye, shape us into your likeness, feed us on your love, and keep us pure in life. Be patient with our ignorance, and be our wisdom, since there’s no one else to turn to. Forgive all our faults, and help us forgive others as generously as you forgive us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord?
body: Heavenly Father, for every blessing of the past night and this new day, we thank you, and we pray that just as you’ve given us rest in sleep, we might now serve you with all the strength this restored life provides. Guide us in everything our hands do today, so that in all things we please you. Help us be kind, loving, forgiving, and watchful against offending you in word, thought, or deed. And as we pray for ourselves, we remember those near and dear to us — parents, siblings, family, and friends. Bless each one our hearts turn to with love, and bring us all at last, unbroken as a family, to our Father’s house above, from which we’ll never depart again. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
body: We sing our hymn of thanksgiving today, God, with voices free of mortal sorrow — a song of new life, not death. In the beginning was the Word, and the Word became flesh, and we’ve seen the glory of your love in the face of Jesus Christ. Come, blessed Creator Spirit, and give us your gifts anew — let Christ be born again in every heart. Clear our ears of the world’s noise, until we’re quick to hear the song of your peace and goodwill toward all. Lead every seeker to their own Bethlehem, to find the holy Child there, and let every nation come to his light. May the kingdoms of this world become the kingdom of our Lord and his Christ, who will reign forever. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Oscar Edward Maurer, D.D., New Haven, Connecticut.

quote: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
body: Father in heaven, thank you for the blessings of another day — your mercy toward us is great. Let us feel your presence in every hour and in every task. Thank you for your Word, a lamp to our feet and a guide for our path — reveal your will to us through it, and enlighten us by your Spirit, in Jesus’ name. Almighty God, before whom every knee must bow, we pray for those in Christian lands who live without you, in rebellion, worshiping according to human invention or temptation. Prosper the efforts of your servants set apart for the ministry of the Word. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Seek the Lord, and his strength.
body: Most gracious God, our Heavenly Father, source of every blessing and giver of every good and perfect gift — we adore you, we praise you, we honor your holy name. Every day brings new proof of your care, new evidence of your love. You’ve provided abundantly for our physical needs — the seasons turn, the sun shines, the rain falls, the harvest never fails; we have homes and friends, and we’re grateful for all of it. Help us be equally grateful for the bread that came down from heaven, the ever-flowing spring of living water, the home not built by human hands, and the friend who sticks closer than a brother. We remember with sympathy people of every condition — the poor, the destitute, the helpless. Bless our home; may it always be a place where you dwell, your presence in our midst, guiding us in all your ways. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Whatsoever we ask, we receive of him.
body: God, our Heavenly Father, by whose good hand we’ve been brought to see this new day and its duties, we lift our hearts in praise for your continued goodness. We humble ourselves before you, confessing we’re unworthy of anything you give — we’ve sinned daily in thought, word, and deed, yet you’ve been patient with our shortcomings. Grant us real repentance and your Holy Spirit, that we might love you fully and honor your name, through Jesus Christ our Lord. As we take up today’s responsibilities, we ask for wisdom to guide us — steady our steps, and give us the strength of body and mind to do our work well. While diligent in our work, let us stay fervent in spirit, serving the Lord — doing justice, loving mercy, and walking humbly with you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Thou wast a God that forgavest them.
body: Father, you forgive us as far as we’re truly sorry — help us forgive in the same way everyone who wrongs us, wrongs society, or wrongs you, just as you forgive us and them. Let us count no sin too serious to pardon, no person too hardened to reach, no one too fallen to lift up. When we forgive someone who’s truly sorry, help us stand by them against a harsh, unforgiving world, making our forgiveness real and opening a door back to genuine life for those who’ve gone astray. Help us find our deepest joy in work that joins our hands, minds, and hearts to your power and love — choosing the task that best serves the world’s deepest need, and doing it with such skill and joy that it carries something of the strength of mountains and the gladness of sunshine. Let us become not just your creatures, but your co-workers. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The Lord upholdeth all that fall.
body: Lord, Heavenly Father, you know how easily we forget you in life’s busy rush, especially when health and success favor us — yet you’re always our ready refuge in illness, grief, and failure. Forgive our lack of gratitude and our selfish neglect of you. We’re earthly and unworthy of our heavenly parentage, and yet we’re still your children. We don’t mean to be disobedient or forgetful of your mercy — it’s only because your care has been so constant since our earliest days that we sometimes take it for granted and fail to remember your tenderness. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I will praise thee with my whole heart.
body: Dear Father, thank you for a restful night’s sleep and your constant care. Now we look to you for a blessing as we begin a new day — may we pass through it unharmed. Let us not fail in our work; let us remember and honor you in every word and act. Give us love for you in our hearts, and complete trust that you’ll guide us toward what’s good for us. Supply everything we need, and make us happy in your love. Bless your people everywhere, and help missionaries and ministers in their work, so that everyone on earth soon learns of Jesus Christ and his desire to save them. Help those in need, and strengthen the weak; remember everyone dear to us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth.
body: Gracious Father, we want to take stock of this day in your presence. It’s your gift to us — new, a sign of your unfailing care; clean, and may we keep it that way, returning it to you so full of good that the day pleases you, honors our living Lord, and helps everyone we live and work with. Give us some fresh sense of yourself today, some deeper experience of your grace, a clearer view of where we’re called to serve, and more joy in doing it. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
body: Father, we thank you that Christ has led us to you, and now in his name we ask for your perfect blessing. Refresh us with your joyful strength; we humbly wait for your Spirit’s work in and through us. Cleanse our hearts and free our lives from everything that holds us back, shaping us into the mind and habits of Christ. Lift our thoughts from ourselves to the needs of others, and let us see the fields of humanity ready for harvest. Lay heavy work on us, and give us the reaper’s joy in the Kingdom’s sure reward. Let us give so generously that those who receive become generous too, correcting ourselves without mercy and others in love, so that both of us welcome the change. Provide for our real needs out of your endless abundance. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Have faith in God.
body: Father in heaven, we come into your presence with full hearts, thankful for your many mercies — first, that you let us call you “Father,” and that out of tender compassion you’re always ready to receive us in love and help us overcome our own weakness. Thank you for your wonderful invitation — whoever wants to may freely take the water of life — and that “whoever” includes us, and that when we come to you in repentance, we’re never turned away. Father, let us see more clearly what you’re willing to do for us. Make us ready to answer your call to carry your message to others, giving someone a real sense of you and your love. Let each of us be a willing instrument in your hands for your kingdom, with an open mind toward every daily chance to help others. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Save with thy right hand, and hear me.
body: All-Wise and Ever-Living Father, we’ve been called to consciousness of another day. Sunshine, flowers, and birdsong summon us to worship at your feet — you’ve placed us in a beautiful world, refreshed by nature’s songs and fragrance, where the heavens themselves declare your glory. We come with all our shortcomings; we’ve sinned against great light and deserve to be cast away, but thank you for your patient love instead. Help us realize religion isn’t a cloak to put on and off at will — spare us from wasting your time, and let us pursue worthy work with our eye fixed on your glory. Have mercy on those rejecting your Word, and let Christ find a place in their hearts, that they might know him as their own Savior. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Pray to thy Father, which seeth in secret.
body: Heavenly Father, we bow humbly before you, asking to remember our dependence on you all day. Give us a vision of the upward path, and make us aware of your holy presence. Guard us against every temptation to do wrong; sharpen our conscience with Christian truth, so we’re not deceived by error. Fill us with love, and give us a disposition like our Master’s. Help us serve you in all our work, and carry our burdens with us. By your grace, teach us to seek first your kingdom and righteousness; work in us the courage of faith and the peace of trust. Let your Spirit fill our home. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.
body: Great God of Hosts, who reigns above and in our hearts, thank you for today’s gracious blessings that strengthen us. Let our gratitude show not just in words, but in every thought and deed, drawing us closer to you — we want to praise you with our lives, not only our prayers. Forgive our weaknesses and faults, which so easily grow into real wrongdoing — cover them instead with your eternal love. Restore our wills, too easily bent toward sin, and cleanse our thoughts, planting seeds of righteousness in our minds. Root out selfishness and pride, and plant instead a love of truth and a longing for a Christlike life, with the knowledge to reach it. If trials come, Jesus, stay near; if temptation comes, fill our hearts with holy resolve to resist it. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do.
body: You, God, are our Father, and we’re children of your eternal love. Help us live our lives aware of your presence; let nothing unworthy claim our hearts, and let us find our peace in your will. Let your likeness form in us, so our lives overflow with the love, peace, and joy of your Spirit. Help us love you wholeheartedly, and love everyone you love. Bless everyone we should pray for — we name them silently in our hearts. Have pity on the ungrateful, the wayward, the wandering; comfort the lonely and the desolate. Let your peace rule in our hearts and our home — we want nothing in heaven or earth besides you. When we stumble, let your strength hold us up, your wisdom guide us, and your love redeem us. Open our hearts to welcome you as our constant companion through life. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Hugh Thomson Kerr, D.D., Pittsburgh, Pa.

quote: I will not leave you comfortless.
body: God, our Heavenly Father, thank you for your love, wisdom, power, grace, and mercy. You’ve placed an infinite longing for you in our hearts, and in your absence we feel it like an orphan’s ache — we have longings only you can satisfy, sins only you can cleanse, and weaknesses that shame us without your help. Thank you for your forgiving love, your protecting care, your comforting presence. Guide us through every path of life — wisdom in confusion, strength in weakness, comfort in sorrow, courage in our struggles, and patience in hard work, so we don’t grow weary in doing good, but truly represent the Christ we claim to follow. You know our sorrows and trials — turn them toward our deepest spiritual good, and let the song of your love fill our souls and shape every part of our lives. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He is risen.
body: For the light of this holy Sabbath, with all its recurring blessings, we thank you, God. For the memory it stirs of Christ rising from the dead on this very day of the week, we praise you. For the hope it renews, that a rest still remains for your people, we call on our whole souls to bless your holy name. Make straight paths for our feet today, and help us walk them. Bless us in worship and in quiet reflection at home; make this a day of rest and gladness. Let it be a great day for your kingdom, marked by many souls brought from darkness into your marvelous light. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.
body: 103:13–17 Dear Father, you’ve given us the great gift of a new day. Let it be to us a Father’s house of love, where we serve not as slaves but as free people, not as strangers but as friends, not as outsiders but as children and heirs. Just as children run to their mothers when weary or troubled, may we come to you in every hour of need. As our parents’ confidence and love give us strength for duty, how much more should the knowledge of your love enable us to carry every burden and overcome every temptation. Let us walk in such close companionship with your Son today that truth, purity, and hope remain in us until evening falls, and we sleep again beneath your protecting wings. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Daniel Russell, D.D., New York City.

quote: He is their help and their shield.
body: Lord, our Father in heaven, thank you for our home — its mercies, joys, shelter, and peace. Help us be your children within it, making it a place Christ would love to visit, like the home at Bethany. Help us bear one another’s burdens today, being burden-bearers rather than burden-makers, practicing the Golden Rule in everything. Give us grace to control our tempers and our words. Bless everyone staying home to work today, that they might do it cheerfully, and bless those heading out to work, prospering them and keeping them from temptation, remembering that a good name is worth more than riches. Bless the children at school, giving them diligence and ambition, and protect them from bad influences. Bless the children at home, that their play may be innocent and joyful. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I have laid help upon one that is mighty.
body: God, our Father, we believe in you — that you exist, and that you reward everyone who earnestly seeks you. So we come confidently in prayer, through Jesus Christ our Redeemer. We only dimly grasp your greatness and perfection, and we’re keenly aware of our own limits and sins — but we feel our need for you; you’re a necessity to us. Without you we can’t truly live, and without you we dare not die. So we turn to you the way flowers turn toward the sun, the way rivers find their way to the sea — you made us for yourself, and our souls can’t rest until they rest in you. Pour the riches of your love into our poor hearts; steady our wavering faith, clear our vision, and deepen our desire to be free from sin. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: O taste and see that the Lord is good.
body: Lord, our Father, help us begin this day with worthy thoughts of you. Your mercies are new every morning, calling for fresh gratitude — we slept and woke, and you were still with us. Let the same goodness that watched over us in the night stay with us through the day. We’re weak, ignorant, and prone to carelessness — be our light, our guide, our shield. Bless our home and family, filling it with love, peace, and kindness. Defend us from harm today, and help us overcome sin in our own lives. Remember with mercy the sick, the hungry, the helpless, and the homeless, and have mercy on prisoners and unbelievers. Strengthen your Church, that it may bring your kingdom’s victory quickly, through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Forgive, and ye shall be forgiven.
body: With grateful hearts, Father, we humbly gather around this family altar. We’re your children, and we confess our sins, acknowledging your loving kindness and tender mercy. Forgive our sins, and create forgiving hearts in us — make us as willing to forgive as we are to be forgiven. Broaden our sympathy, and save us from selfishness; open our ears to the needs of our neighbors and to every call for help. Multiply our chances to do good, and devote our energy to your service. Warm our hearts to respond to others’ needs, and make us bearers of strength and comfort to the discouraged. Fill us with your Spirit, energize us with your love, and use us for your glory, strengthening us in temptation and sustaining us through dark valleys. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go.
body: We praise your name, Father, for bringing us again to the sweet awareness of life and your grace. We’re grateful for every mercy given through your Son — grant us your watchful guidance today, so we never offend you or bring shame on your name. Let your Spirit lead us into the truth that lets us glorify you in our lives — keep our minds from error and our hearts from sin, so our thoughts are honest, our love pure, and our actions right. Give us and our family what we need for both body and soul, and bless our work so it serves others and honors you. Help us stay aware of the presence of your Son, our Savior and friend. Comfort those in sorrow, and strengthen the weak. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: They continued steadfastly in prayer.
body: Gracious Lord, we bring you again today the praise of our lips and the worship of our hearts. We bless you for the care of our bodies, the guarding of our minds, and the joy our awakened spirits find in you. We haven’t earned even your smallest mercy, and yet our lives are crowned daily with countless signs of your infinite love. Give us fresh humility, a deeper sense of our dependence on you, and fuller surrender to your will. Give us the peace that comes from Christ’s infinite sacrifice, a life shaped by his presence within us, and the power, through your Spirit, to serve and honor you. Help us walk in constant prayer, delight increasingly in your Word, love one another, and share the gospel’s light with those in darkness — and amid all the noise and stress of the world, let our souls rest in your perfect calm. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
body: Revelation 14:12 God, our Heavenly Father, you’ve been good and gracious to us. This morning you gave us a day, every minute meant for service to you and to others — help us use each of these minutes for your honor and your kingdom’s advance, so that at day’s end, we return every hour just as sacred as when we received it at dawn. Thank you for your boundless love and protection, which has sheltered us from harm. You’re our friend, the Lord of hosts, standing by us through everything — when other friends have deserted us, you’ve stayed closer than a brother. We sense you speaking to us even now, so near, and we know you’ll keep and protect us through the night. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus.
body: God, we come to you because you already are, in yourself, everything we long to become. We’re weak, but you’re strong, and we come seeking your strength. We’re sinful, but you’re holy, and we come seeking your holiness. We’re ignorant, but you’re wise, and we come seeking your wisdom. Bless us, that our character might reflect your purity; help us, that our hearts might reflect your goodness; aid us, that our lives might reflect your kindness. Let us become all that you are, thinking your thoughts, walking in the steps of the one who went about doing good, our wills brought into harmony with your purpose and our lives shaped by your eternal righteousness. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by W. W. — (name incomplete in source).

quote: This is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
body: Almighty and merciful God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, worthy of all human praise, hear our prayers today. You’re holy, and all your creatures should worship you — let everyone in this house truly fear, love, and trust you above everything. We bless you for your goodness and tender mercy, especially the gift of your Son and the Bible, the revelation of your will and grace. Our lives, unworthy as they are, have been precious in your sight; you’ve provided for our bodies and fed our souls on the Bread of Life. Continue your blessing on us — cover us with your mercy, empty us of pride, forgive our sins, and plant your Word in us so we bear fruit through patient faithfulness. Graciously protect us from sickness, disaster, and want, and help us take your fatherly correction to heart. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The Lord God is a sun and shield.
body: Lord, thank you for the blessings of the day just passed — you guarded and guided every step, withholding no good thing. We ask your forgiving mercy as we begin today’s duties and face its dangers. Cleanse us in your love, comfort us with your presence, strengthen us with your power, and help us, like children, put our hand in yours and let you lead us all day. Deepen our gratitude, and help us rest close to you the way John rested close to his Lord. Let us stay busy today so we’re blessed and become a blessing to others. We pray for the whole world, but especially for those dear to us — bless our family, and make it so happy and pure that it feels like a piece of heaven. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. M. M. Davis, Dallas, Texas.

quote: How shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
body: God, our Father, thank you that we’re allowed to come to you. Though you’re holy and we know how unfit we are, our Savior’s suffering and death assure us that you love and will forgive us. Thank you that we can come so freely and pour out everything in our hearts. We’re keenly aware of our weakness — give us strength. We often fail to do what we should; help our lives become genuinely useful to others. You know how much falls to our hands to do — give us moments of quiet rest in the midst of it, and keep us from anxiety and complaint. Give us trust in you that stills the soul, seeing you at work in every part of our lives. You’ve meant so much to us — help us live in a way that leads others, near and far, to know and love you too. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith.
body: Father, whenever we kneel in prayer, the wonder of your love overwhelms us — we’re moved by the memory of Calvary, amazed at the mercy that forgives sin, in awe of the goodness that has followed us all our lives. But it’s hard to keep that glow once we rise and face the stress and disappointment of ordinary life — we’re prone to forget your love then. Help us, on our bitterest days as well as our brightest, feel you so vividly that we act like people held by an unspeakable love. Give us such a lasting memory of your mercy that we find it hard to be unmerciful to others, and keep us so alive to your goodness that evil becomes hateful to us. Let the vision of Calvary shape us so deeply that we don’t hesitate to make real sacrifices for someone in need. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Pray unto me, and I will hearken.
body: Father, thank you for your presence, our home, our health and strength, and the many friends we have. Help us be friendly and worthy of friendship with everyone noble and good. Forgive us for today’s sins — for the wrong we’re aware of and the wrong we’re not, for every thought that fell short of your standard, we ask your pardon, trusting your promise that confessed sin is forgiven and cleansed. Bless everyone we love and everyone we ought to pray for. We think of our church and Sunday school, and every effort everywhere to build your kingdom — favor them all. Bless our family, and make us a blessing to others; help us love and serve each other, staying genuine at home, school, work, and play, so we’re truly what, at our best, we appear to be. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Guy Lamson, D.D., Philadelphia, Pa.

quote: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
body: Dear Heavenly Father, thank you for the sleep and rest we found last night under your protecting wing, and for the opportunities this new day brings. We ask for strength to overcome evil and do our work well, showing the spirit of Christ in everything we think, say, and do. Bless our absent friends and loved ones, keeping them in your care. Remember with mercy the tempted, the tried, and the afflicted, sustaining them by your grace. Give wisdom and strength to our leaders, and sustain everyone laboring to build your kingdom at home and abroad, hastening the day when all people know and obey you. For Jesus’ sake. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. Howard A. — (name incomplete in source).

quote: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me.
body: Father in heaven, thank you that we’re not orphans, but your own sons and daughters. Hallowed be your name — may our whole lives be devoted to honoring it throughout the earth. Let your kingdom come in its full power, spreading until the kingdoms of this world become the kingdom of our Lord and his Christ. Let your will be done on earth, gladly and joyfully, just as it’s done in heaven. Give us our daily bread, and teach us to be content with what we have, since godliness with contentment is great gain. Lead us away from temptation, and deliver us from evil, for the kingdom is yours. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart.
body: Father, you’ve given us this sweet morning light — give us also, we ask, the morning blessing that fills the whole day with sweetness. Let today’s duties, however unwelcome, become a delight as we hear you calling us forward into them, confident we’ll find you already there, ready to give the strength we need. Let every relationship in and beyond our home be shaped by your hand, removing everything base or dishonest. When night comes, let us look back on a day when we lightened others’ burdens and filled hopeless hearts with hope. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for your past mercies and your watchful care through the night. Standing at the edge of a new day, we look to you for help and guidance — we need your presence every passing hour. Make us strong to resist temptation, and give us courage to do your will in everything. Open our eyes to every chance to serve you and others, and help us live in a way that commends Christ to everyone around us. Remember with us everyone we should pray for — the sick, the sorrowing, the distressed, and the needy. Bless every effort to extend your kingdom, and hasten the day when all people love and serve you. Graciously forgive whatever you’ve seen amiss in our lives, and supply all our needs from your abundant riches. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us.
body: God and Father, we offer thanks and praise for all the good of this day — your mercies were new this morning, and your love is sweet again this evening. Thank you for our daily bread, and for not forgetting us even in the self-centered moments when we forgot you. Watch over and preserve us, body and soul, through the hours ahead. Let our rest be sweet, and bring us to tomorrow refreshed and ready for whatever it holds, its sorrows and its joys alike. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: but one thing is needful.
body: Merciful Savior, who blessed the humble home at Nazareth with your quiet, humble life — inspire in us today such a willing readiness to do our Father’s work that no task feels too small for our care, and no burden too great for our effort. Hear us and help us, so that each day, whether at home, at worship, or at work, our lives are devoted to loving service of God and others, and we, like you, go about doing good, through your sufficient grace, whose strength shows itself perfectly in our weakness. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
body: Father, we adore you as the source of every pure spirit, and we ask you to make us pure. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The Lord is the strength of my life.
body: Heavenly Father, you’ve promised that as our days are, so our strength will be. Thank you for your sustaining grace through the day gone by, and we ask your favor for the day ahead. Help us be kind to everyone we meet, and don’t let us be tempted beyond what we can bear. Let us be helpful to our fellow travelers on life’s road, guided by the spirit of the one who came not to be served, but to serve and give his life for others. Let us never be a stumbling block to anyone, but live worthy of our calling, putting real heart into our work. We claim your promise that your angels watch over us in all our ways — if it’s your will, keep us safe through the day and night. Let us be pure in heart, that we might see God, and let our speech honor the name of Christ we bear. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ?
body: God, kneeling at this family altar, we trustingly call you our Father. As a family we worship you, asking for your guidance and strength for today’s unknown challenges, trusting that perfect love casts out fear of you, of the night, or of tomorrow. We acknowledge you as our Lord — help us obey your law and do your will, and don’t let us stumble through ignorance, err through forgetfulness, or falter through fear. We confess our sins humbly, and wait for your forgiveness — have mercy on us, God. Make us pure, kind, and unselfish, and grant us the blessing promised to those who hunger for righteousness. Deliver us from selfishness, pride, envy, and bitterness. Make this a good day for our family — be our shield, our refuge, and our strong fortress. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I love them that love me.
body: Father, we thank you for the night and for this pleasant morning light, for rest, food, and loving care, and everything that makes the day so good. We’re glad for the privilege of calling on you — we love you for who you are and for what you’ve done. You’re the Creator and Sustainer of our lives; in you we live and move and exist. Thank you for your Son, in whom we have redemption, forgiveness, and the hope of eternal life. Thank you for our country, homes, schools, and churches. Help us love what’s right and reject what’s wrong; prepare us for today’s duties — we don’t know what lies ahead, but each day has enough trouble of its own, so give us grace to overcome evil with good. Bless our friends and neighbors, and all your followers everywhere. Let your kingdom come, and your will be done, in Jesus’ name. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. J. W. Stiverson, Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

quote: Let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God.
body: As morning breaks gently over us, Lord, waking us to another day of light and labor, we bow before your mercy seat. Here we leave our sins, set down our burdens, and take hold of the full assurance of your favor. Let your face shine on us clearly today; give us grace to set our hearts on what matters most, saved from pettiness in thought, word, and deed, so our lives draw their inspiration from something higher. Help us hold a tender regard for all of God’s children, whatever they’re called. Our eyes are turned to you, God — let our hearts rest in the assurance that we’re accepted in Christ. Let us offer ourselves as instruments of your righteousness, growing in grace and knowledge today, and through our service to others in Christ’s name, help lead someone into a deeper experience of his abundant grace. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
body: Through your mercy and love, God, we get to greet another day — your guardian angels have watched over us when we couldn’t watch over ourselves, and restful sleep has renewed us. Help us walk uprightly today, so no good thing is withheld from us, and don’t let us grow careless about opportunities to serve. Let your Word be a source of strength that we treasure more with each passing year. Bless the sick and the tempted; strengthen the weak and comfort the sorrowing. Bless our ministers and missionaries, and everyone devoted to your kingdom’s work. As we part ways for the day’s duties, stay with us at home, school, and work, and at day’s end let us realize that even the ordinary tasks have brought us closer to you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us.
body: Father, we come to you thankful, remembering the night’s rest and this new day’s light. Every day is a record of your tender mercy, your provision, your patient love — we don’t need to test your love, since you’ve already overwhelmed us with more than we ever thought to ask for. You’re both the promise and its fulfillment, and we’ve found the yoke easy and the burden light, working alongside your Son, Jesus Christ. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Your heart shall live that seek God.
body: Lord, our gracious Father, we bring you our thanks for all your kindness and love — for every mercy we remember and every one we’ve forgotten. We bless you for how you’ve led us so far, and since you’ve been so gracious in the past, we can hope in you completely for the future. Strengthen us to draw near you with humble, obedient hearts, and stir in us a deeper desire to call on your name with real submission and faith. We admit that in our daily work we often forget you, for whose sake it should all be done, and that we give in too easily to temptation, living as though this world were all there is. Deliver us from overvaluing what’s only temporary. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
body: Almighty God, pour out your Spirit on us this morning, giving us a clear sense of your presence as we stand at the edge of a new day. Guide us surely through every hour, leading us into wider usefulness. Fill our ordinary path with beauty, and set plenty and good cheer at our table. Deepen the qualities of our hearts, and push us into new areas of service. Help us, loving Father, see life at its highest, with a real sense of the world’s deep need. By your grace, help us reflect the spirit and purpose of Jesus Christ to everyone we meet today, so that people see something of God’s face in ours. Deepen our appreciation for the gospel of Jesus Christ, which lifts, redeems, and beautifies everything it touches. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
body: God, our Father and our Mother — thank you that you pity us as a father pities his children, and comfort us as a mother comforts hers. Thank you for our home, and for the home it points us toward, where we hope to be forever with you and each other. We praise you for every good thing that comes to us, and ask that we never forget to be grateful. Our eyes are closed, shutting out everything else; we bow before you, aware of our dependence on you — we have nothing in our hands to buy blessing with. God, keep us from anything that grieves you, and make us eager all day to serve you by serving others, bringing gladness rather than sorrow into people’s lives. We pray for the whole world in its great need of you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Frank S. Dobbins, D.D., Philadelphia, Pa.

quote: Whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for this day and its opportunities to serve, for food and clothing, for friends and loved ones. We bless your name for letting us take part in telling a lost world about Jesus. Make us channels of blessing today — let our Redeemer’s light show in our lives, so that everyone who meets us recognizes we’ve been with you. Bless us in our daily work, whether at home, in business, or in the classroom, so we’re faithful to you everywhere, doing everything for God’s glory. Be with our absent loved ones, and bless our city and its leaders. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
body: God, our Heavenly Father, we worship you. Thank you for rest through the night and for the morning light — you’re the light of our spirits. Just as plants turn toward the sun, and flowers reach even from shady places toward the light, we look up to you, the Sun of Righteousness. Let your Spirit’s influence fill our hearts all day, cleansing our thoughts and strengthening every good purpose in us. Be with us in work and rest alike — if trials come, let us be patient; if burdens come, let us carry them with courage. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary.
body: Heavenly Father, with reverence and humility we bow at your throne of grace to find mercy for our daily needs. Aware of our weakness and sin, we earnestly seek your forgiveness, glad to know that you pity us as a father pities his children. Thank you for our home, and for the love that makes home life sweet. Give each member of our family the particular blessing they need. Deepen our sympathy, save us from selfishness, and teach us patience and self-control. Keep us from hasty or unkind words, and from misjudging others, and free us from anxiety and complaint. Fill your Church with missionary zeal and the presence of your Spirit; strengthen the weak, and comfort the sorrowing. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let us come boldly unto the throne of grace.
body: God, our loving Father in heaven, we look up to you with reverence, trust, and love. Thank you for teaching us to come boldly to your throne of grace. With sorrow we confess our sin and ask forgiveness; with trust we bring our weakness and ask for strength; with love we bring our hearts and ask you to fill them completely. Lead us forward step by step, shaping our path according to your wisdom, and help us stay faithful throughout. Bless our loved ones and everyone we should pray for. Let your peace fill the world, and let your kingdom come quickly. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
body: God, Father of every family on earth, who unites people in one household — bless this family, we ask, and let its members be so united in faith that you make your home in them, drawing others to know, love, and serve you through them. Free us from the sins of years past, showing us where we’ve displeased you — our selfishness, pride, and anger — and making us truly sorry. Give us courage today to be true to you in thought, word, and deed. Make us patient, humble, pure, cheerful, and fair. Strengthen us to stand for the rights of the poor and oppressed against the arrogance of the powerful, and bring us at last to your heavenly kingdom. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I will praise thy name for thy loving kindness.
body: God, our Heavenly Father, thank you today for our health and strength, our homes, our loved ones, and every blessing you give us daily — but more than anything, we thank you for the gift of your Son, Jesus Christ. Thank you for giving him to us for thirty-three years, and that he shed his blood and gave his life as a ransom for our sins. Help us die to self and sin today; forgive us for yesterday’s mistakes, and let them become stepping stones to something better. Breathe your Christlike spirit into our lives, so it shines through our eyes and speaks through our words. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice.
body: We bow humbly before you, Lord our Father, offering praise for all your loving kindness and tender mercy. Everything we have, are, and hope for, we owe to your goodness. We humbly ask you to forgive our sins and cleanse us from every stain of wrongdoing. Help us walk blamelessly before you, resisting every temptation and faithfully doing every duty set before us. Bless our absent loved ones according to their needs. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Love suffereth long, and is kind.
body: Most merciful God, to whom we belong and from whom we receive everything we need, accept the gratitude of our hearts for your fatherly care. We’ve sinned and fallen short of your glory — be merciful, and forgive all our sins, for the sake of the one who loved us and gave himself for us. Let Christ’s love abound in our hearts and show itself in our daily lives. Let the Holy Spirit enlighten our minds so we truly understand your Word, making it food for our souls and light for our path. Let the Spirit comfort us and help us set down every burden that hinders our growth, delivering us from the power of temptation. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace.
body: Merciful God and Heavenly Father, we thank you warmly for every blessing of the past. Continue your watchful care and protection over us today, as you have every day. Keep everyone in this household safe from physical harm and from every evil thought that would hurt the soul. Teach us what’s right, and make us wise and strong enough to do your will. Comfort the sick, the sorrowful, the poor, and the distressed, and put it in our hearts to help them, showing us how. Bless and guide your Church — give its ministers wisdom, zeal, and faithfulness, and make every member ready to do your will. Call sinners to repentance, and inspire your people toward obedience and service, through our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Bishop Francis Key Brooks, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

quote: Thanksgiving... be unto our God for ever and ever.
body: God of heaven and earth, who established the home and made it holy — we bless you for this, our home. May it be a place where you dwell, where your Spirit reigns supreme, a real home in every sense of the word. Let the homemaker feel your presence and strength today, and let the provider be guided and sustained by you at work, through every trial, and brought home safely when the day’s work is done, to rest in this home. Don’t let anything mar our family relationships — let every member be faithful and true to each other, parents teaching by example as much as by word, and children treasuring what they learn, so that we all become what we ought to be in God’s sight. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Llewellyn L. Henson, D.D., Pueblo, Colorado.

quote: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving.
body: Lord God, our Father, Savior, and Guide, by whose gracious providence we’ve been sustained to this hour, and in whose redeeming love we greatly rejoice — accept the sincere gratitude of our hearts for your unfailing mercy. Forgive, we ask, all our failings and faults. By your indwelling Spirit, sweeten our disposition and temper our desires. Make our home holy, lit continually by your presence and warmed by your love. Make your way clear before us, and lead us onward and upward. Sanctify our trials and difficulties to us; help us through hard places, and in easy times don’t let us forget how much we still need you. Deepen our love for you, and help us be compassionate and generous with everyone we deal with, doing justly, loving kindness, and walking humbly with you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
body: Almighty God, Father of all grace, we adore you as the source of our being, our protector, and our redeemer. Cleanse us from our inherited sinfulness and from every stain picked up living in a sinful world. Pour a double portion of your Spirit’s power on your ministers, on every Christian worker, and on all your people who make up your kingdom on earth. Let your children show the kindness and helpfulness that Christ showed while on earth. Work in us a spirit of forgiveness toward everyone who has wronged us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth.
body: Almighty God, our Father and Protector, who refreshed us with the night’s sleep and woke us to a new day’s duties — grant us your presence, so we do our work as if under the eye of a great and gracious Master. You who redeemed us by mercy, defend us by grace from evil, without and within. Save us from our own desires, the subtle tricks of our own thoughts, and the treachery of our own hearts, and let your face shine on us, so that today and every day, we walk in the light as children of light. We ask it through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. T. B. McCorkindale.

quote: He shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever.
body: 14:15–16 Almighty God and Heavenly Father, who has safely kept us through sleep and darkness and brought us again to light and the joy of living — we adore your name and bless you for mercies renewed every day. Let your truth guide our steps, and your Spirit rule our hearts through all of life’s changes, so we’re never caught off guard by sin, but kept calm and courageous on the path ahead, with a clear conscience toward everyone. We offer you our whole selves, body and soul. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust.
body: Gracious Lord, guide and bless us today, that we might grow more like your Son in every wonderful quality of his character. We ask to have the mind of Christ — the mind of perfect humility — that we’d willingly take up his cross of self-denial as one of the true privileges of following him. Let us know his Spirit, since human wisdom alone can’t equip us for life’s demands. Let us share his purity, his confidence born of perfect faith, and the joy of his perfect peace — a peace that exists because nothing divides your heart from ours. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God.
body: Heavenly Father, we come this morning with praise and thanks for your care and love. We’re grateful for every earthly blessing and for the loved ones we have to enjoy. Thank you for the gift of your Son and your Holy Spirit. Forgive our sins, and cleanse us from all wrongdoing. Be with us today, and help us be kind and considerate, more like you. Open our eyes to opportunities to serve you and help others know you, since knowing you rightly is eternal life. Be with everyone preaching or teaching salvation at home or abroad, and let their words not go to waste. Be with our leaders, that they’d rule justly. Comfort, as a mother comforts her child, everyone in trouble and sorrow. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.
body: 16:2–3 Father, who art in heaven, you’re our Father, even though we’re of the earth and imperfect in your sight. You love us, and we’re your children — your goodness shows in that you hear our prayers. Thank you for so many signs of your favor and lasting love. Help us live as your children should, learning more of you as the days rush toward eternity. Let all our strength and service be devoted to you, and let it be our constant joy to follow wherever you lead, trusting that you always design the best path for us. Teach us your way, and keep our feet on it — in life’s hard places, help us, Lord, for we’re weak and sometimes fall. We need you every hour; keep us from sin, and save us now and always, for the sake of Jesus, our Master. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. W. W. Van Dusen, Boise, Idaho.

quote: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
body: Father, you’re in heaven, and you’re also on earth — you stretched out your hand and darkness fell, and you’ve stretched it out again and light has flooded the world. We thank you for the morning light and for the night’s rest. Give us today wisdom for our problems, courage for our work, patience for our labor, strength for our burdens, and faith for our efforts. Let us spend this day so that our work becomes our worship, reflecting Christ’s glory to everyone around us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by William Robert King, D.D., St. Louis, Missouri.

quote: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts.
body: God, we thank you for your great goodness and unfailing kindness — day after day you give us exactly what we need. Teach us to use these gifts so that everything we do glorifies your name and serves your righteous cause. Above all, merciful Father, we bless you for Jesus Christ, your Son, our Savior. For his sake, receive us, and give us your Spirit, so we can follow in his footsteps and grow more like him. Prepare us, Heavenly Father, for everything your wise providence has planned, that we might be diligent, brave, and faithful through it all. We commend to your care everyone dear to us, and everyone everywhere in need of you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Thy statutes.
body: Dear Father in heaven, we come to you in love and praise for all the blessings we enjoy — for the food we eat, the water we drink, the clothes we wear, and the fresh air we breathe. We thank you for the open Bible, but above all we thank you for leading us out of darkness into light through the gift of your Son. Father, help us become worthy of your favor, in the name of Jesus we ask it. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. John L. Brandt, St. Louis, Missouri.

quote: In every work that he began... he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
body: Chronicles 31:21 Kind Heavenly Father, we come to worship you this morning. We’ve rested safely under your care through the night, and can say, like your servant of old, “When I awake, I am still with you.” Your mercies are new every morning, renewed with the night. Thank you for morning light and morning gifts, and for today’s opportunities to serve you. Help us enter into today’s work cheerfully — give us strength for our labor, clarity for our decisions, and grace to overcome every temptation. Help us live in a way that shows others we’ve been with Jesus. Remember graciously all our loved ones, near and far, and let us feel that we share one Father even when separated. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help.
body: We rejoice, God, that we’re not lonely orphans in this world — we can look to you and call you our Father. Help us notice your nearness; amid the day’s rush, quiet our hearts so we hear your voice and understand your message rightly. Thank you for bright sunshine, blue skies, fresh air, and good food. We’re grateful for the chance to study and reflect, for uplifting books, for good friends and loving companions. Let our lives, not just our words, express our gratitude — speak through our voices, work through our hands, send our feet on your errands, and let Christ’s mind be ours. Save us from laziness and selfishness; fill us with cheer, and help us brighten every life we touch. Remove all malice from us, and help us flee evil and pursue what’s right. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins.
body: Almighty God of heaven, earth, and sea, God of our ancestors and of every nation — hear us. Forgive our sins, and remove our wrongs far from us; help us see your glory. Help us see the beauty of your law and feel the power of your love. Give us broad faith, bright hope, strong love, and a firm step for life’s duties. Let our hearts sing with joy remembering your goodness, and keep us strong enough to serve you. We praise you for your many blessings, not only to us as individuals but as a people and nation — thank you for our ancestors and the blessings passed down to us through them. Give us the grace to live useful, helpful lives. Let wars and conflict cease, and let the kingdoms of this world become the kingdom of our Lord and his Christ. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
body: Dear Father, at the start of another day, after the quiet rest of the night, we come before you thankful that you’ve spared us to see this day — for every day is yours, every hill and stream and creature belongs to you. So why should we worry over the temporary things of life, knowing you’re both able and willing to care for us and provide for every need? We come to you boldly, trusting you for everything necessary to sustain us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
body: Heavenly Father, in the light of another day we rise to do your will. We bless you for the comfort and rest of the night, and for the promise of strength for today. Let us find joy in our work, and quiet amid the noise and strife of the world. Let your still, small voice guide us toward what’s good, and let your Spirit keep our eyes from tears, our feet from stumbling, and our souls from death today. Bless everyone we hold dear, and do for them far more than we know how to ask. Forgive every wrong we’re sorry for, and keep us close to you today. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The Lord is my light and my salvation.
body: Heavenly Father, we, this household with all our varied needs, unite to honor your name, wanting to glorify you in ordinary life. Thank you for the quiet shining of light on the world, and for the quiet shining of your light in human souls — light our path, so we don’t lose our way. Let Jesus be the honored guest at our table, listening to every conversation, counseling us in doubt, lighting our darkness, sheltering us in storms, comforting us in grief. Bless us in all we have. Give us all the happiness your wisdom can trust us with, and only as much trial as it takes to purify us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Thou art my God; early will I seek thee.
body: Heavenly Father, who kept us through the night and gave us a new day, thank you for every gift — renewed strength, a refreshed mind, and new opportunities: to learn, to be kind, to work, to pray. We failed yesterday, leaving undone what we should have done and doing what we shouldn’t — but you’ve given us today to begin again. We look to you, giver of every good thing, for help to spend it well. Let your peace fill our hearts, and give us the perfect love that drives out fear. Help us acknowledge you in everything we do, so you can direct our steps. Give us grace enough to overcome temptation, stay patient under trial, and be kind and loving with everyone, faithful even in life’s small things. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Her sins, which are many, are forgiven.
body: Heavenly Father, through the night you blessed us with sleep and rest, and now this new day is your gift too — thank you for both. Help us begin today aware of your reality, your nearness, your love. Give us a fresh sense of your forgiving grace, so past sins don’t haunt us, and your helping grace, so we stand firm against temptation, stay cheerful in our work, and carry any cross of trial bravely. Help us set aside selfishness and unkindness, living a loving life with our family and everyone we deal with. Bring your promises to mind, and make Christ’s saving presence real in our hearts today. And whatever we ask for ourselves, grant, in your goodness, to others too. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me.
body: 10:37–39 Lord, our Heavenly Father, we adore you for your loving kindness and tender mercy — you’ve surrounded us with proof of your care. Thank you for every blessing you’ve given us: life, provision, and hope. Let us feel your presence today, guiding, protecting, and helping us. In trial, give us patience to endure temptation, and make a way of escape. Let your Spirit work in us, knitting us together as one family in Jesus Christ, so that both individually and together, we reflect our Savior’s character in the love we show for God and each other. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Being justified by faith, we have peace with God.
body: We bow before you in united worship, our Father and God, praising you for your faithful shepherd care. Thank you for every support in life, but especially for your Son, our Savior, through whom we’ve become God’s children. Take from us the guilt and power of sin, and teach us today our dependence on you. Give us faith, patience, love, and hope, lifting us above living only for this world. As a family, let us help each other through dark days and bright ones alike; deliver us from every danger, seen and unseen, and let us love and serve others so well that they see you in us. Heal the sick, comfort the sorrowing, and lift up the fallen, and guide each of us until we’re one unbroken family around your throne. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help.
body: We greet you, God of the sunrise — you’ll hear our voice this morning, as we direct our prayer to you and look up. Let us go through this day with head held high, heart full, eyes open to see, and mind ready to learn. Let us be grateful for what we have without envy, and glad to share whatever falls into our hands. We don’t ask for a fortune, but for a mind full of noble thoughts; not for a house full of treasure, but for a home full of your love. Help us walk with you to the very end of this day, so that when evening comes, your promise holds true — that at evening time it shall be light. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another.
body: Thessalonians 3:11–13 Almighty God, our Father, help us receive this day as a fresh gift from your loving hand, using it eagerly and joyfully. Give us, for its tasks, strength of body, clarity of mind, and firm purpose, but above all, the right spirit and a pure heart. Look graciously on our loved ones, guiding and restraining them by your hand. Comfort the sick and sorrowing; heal the wounded in spirit, and bring back the wandering. Strengthen everyone working earnestly for your kingdom, and let today be a day of real progress toward righteousness and peace throughout the world. Let your kingdom come, and your will be done. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.
body: Father, you love us with an everlasting love — let us rejoice in that love, and try day by day to show our love for you through glad obedience to your will. Keep us pure, strong, and full of trust in you, so we overcome every temptation and always know the help of your presence. Banish our selfishness, and stir in us a desire for justice toward everyone, moving our wills to build real Christian brotherhood on earth. Let us look on your whole human family and answer every call for compassion and sympathy. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: My praise shall be continually of thee.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, source of every good thought, give us your Holy Spirit today so we walk humbly before you. You’re the fountain of our light and the source of our strength. Thank you for this home, with all its comforts, and for every sign of your loving kindness we’ve experienced. Be with us today — let every member of our household feel your presence, and let Christ be honored in everything we say and do. Thank you for salvation; make us ready to serve. Let each of us surrender fully to Jesus, giving our time, money, and influence to him without holding back — caring for the lowly, visiting the sick, encouraging the discouraged, and remembering to be fishers of people. Make us wise with your wisdom, and strong with your strength. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: My mouth shall show forth thy praise.
body: Almighty and merciful God, we gratefully acknowledge you as ruler of our lives. You’re the infinite God, and we’re creatures of earth — yet you’ve lifted us up to be your children, given us reason and will, and placed us in this beautiful world, lavishing its gifts on us. You’ve set us in families among neighbors and given us the capacity to love. Above all, because we fell into sin, you showed your redeeming love through the sacrifice of our Savior on the cross. We humbly confess our sinfulness and our failure to fully serve you and others — in mercy, forgive us, and help us live more nobly. Look with compassion on all people; awaken true repentance everywhere, at home and abroad. Expand your kingdom, and reveal your power on earth. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
body: Most gracious Father, from whom every good gift comes, give us the gift we need above all — your Holy Spirit — to purify our worship of everything false. Free us from selfishness in prayer, and from asking only for what pleases us; help us long for the best gifts, the ones we’re too ignorant or too ashamed of our sin to ask for. We know we’re sinful, but we can’t be truly sorry until you move us to honest repentance. We’d be grateful for your countless mercies, but our hearts aren’t ready to praise you until you awaken real gratitude in us. Our love fades unless your Spirit kindles it into a living flame — help us learn to pray without ceasing. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Fight the good fight of faith.
body: We thank you, Heavenly Father, for the care, rest, and refreshment given us through another night. Thank you for the privilege of coming before you again, in a spirit of worship and dedication, for the work of this new day. We recognize that the highest and holiest goal of life is doing your will, and that, as you’ve said, it’s not in us to always direct our own steps rightly — so we look to you for the strength, wisdom, and grace to faithfully meet today’s responsibilities. Make us deeply aware of your presence and the day’s blessings, so nothing passes by unappreciated. Give us patience, sympathy, and a readiness to help anyone less fortunate than ourselves. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: If we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us.
body: With gratitude for your protection through the night watches, Lord, we begin the new life of a new day. Our paths will run through busy places today — walk with us there, unseen. Our thoughts will turn to business — don’t let our hearts cling too tightly to such things, but through your Spirit’s gentle influence, incline us toward what truly lasts. We’ll be tempted today, and may face sudden danger when there’s no time to withdraw and pray — give us the wisdom to know what’s right and the strength to do it. Don’t let small things ruffle our temper, or disappointments discourage us, or heavy duties make us selfish — give us instead a cheerful face, an open hand, and the joy of speaking a helpful word to someone discouraged. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Pray without ceasing.
body: Blessed Savior, who lives in our hearts by faith, give us such a clear sense of your presence in us that each of us could say, “I live, and yet no longer I, but Christ lives in me.” Show us that your interests and ours are one, and help us surrender so completely that you can work through us according to your good pleasure. Rule over every part of our nature; bring our passions and energy under your will. In your light, let us see our faults, and remove them, finishing the work you’ve begun in us. Give us grace today to let Christ live his life through us, so fully that people who see us think of him, and people who talk with us feel his Spirit’s influence. Keep us from becoming so absorbed in worldly pursuits that we lose sight of Christ, who reigns in our souls and is our very life. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace.
body: Almighty God, our gracious Heavenly Father, we, your needy children, draw near to you. We come confidently, since you’ve already shown your care for us today — calling light out of darkness to give us this new day, and raising us from sleep to give us a new chance to do your will. Add to these signs of favor all the goodness and mercy we need — goodness to provide for body and soul, mercy to pardon our past wrongs and protect us from future temptation. Give us grace today to show Christ’s spirit in everything we think, say, and do. Show your favor to everyone near and dear to us, and guide everyone in positions of authority — in church, government, industry, education, and home. Hasten the day when every knee bows before you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Believe that ye shall receive, and ye shall have.
