body: Father in heaven, in the name of Jesus Christ, whom we love though we haven’t seen him, we draw near to you in prayer. We’re unworthy of your many mercies, having sinned against you, but we know you won’t turn away a humble and contrite heart. Thank you for life and its provision, for home and its comfort, for loved ones and friends, and above all for Jesus, who loved us and gave himself for us. Help us follow in his steps, doing and speaking as he would, denying ourselves for others’ sake. Bless your holy Word to us, and help us live by its teaching. In all our dealings with others, give us patience, forgiveness, love, and kindness, so we’re a good influence, and forgive our many sins, keeping us faithful by your power. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Follow after righteousness, godliness, faith.
body: Father, teach us how to speak to you. Let your Spirit lead us into the light, since we know so little about you and learn so slowly. Forgive us when we do wrong, and keep us from wandering from you. Good Shepherd, the wilderness is vast, and we’re weak and easily lost — keep us from sin’s dangers, and never let us miss the path back to your fold. Bless our home today and everyone in it; let us always be gentle and loving, working to make others happy. Give us a bright face, especially for anyone sad or troubled, and teach us to forget ourselves in helping others, the way Jesus did. Thank you for every good and beautiful thing you give us daily — help us help you make your world good and happy. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The prayer of the upright is his delight.
body: Lord, teach us to pray, since we don’t know how to pray as we should. You’ve told us to make our requests known to you through prayer and thanksgiving, and given us such wonderful promises about prayer that we’re sure it’s the open road between us and you. You’re our Father, and we trust that your love for us, shown in the coming and dying of Jesus Christ, could never be contradicted — how could you not, with him, freely give us everything? No delay or denial of our requests can make us doubt you, since we remember your “no” is as real an answer as your “yes” — as it was for Moses and Paul, whose seemingly unanswered prayers you answered wonderfully in time. Be our light in darkness, our comfort in sorrow, our wisdom in confusion, our strength in weakness. We want to be useful to you, not idle or unfruitful in your service. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The God of love and peace shall be with you.
body: Father in heaven, who cares for every family on earth, give this family a real sense of your presence and love. Keep us careful not to dishonor your matchless name by word or deed. Go with us to today’s tasks — let us be strong in your strength, brave because of your promises, and humble, aware of how much we depend on you. Let your angel guard our absent loved ones, protecting them from harm and inspiring them to serve. Give us all hearts of pity for the needy, sympathy for the weak, and a readiness to lift up the fallen. Don’t let us grow content with our own comfort or proud of our own success, but keep us, like children, eager for our Father’s glory and grateful for his care. Forgive us wherever we’ve failed. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Believe ye that I am able to do this?
body: God, our Heavenly Father, we thank you for everything that makes you known to us, and for every good gift you’ve given. We praise you that our household has once more been kept in health, able to gather in common thanksgiving to you, the Most Holy God. Forgive all our sins, and cleanse our hearts by your Spirit. Go with us into today’s duties, and give us strength for every need. Protect us from danger, guard us from wrong thinking, and deliver us from temptation — save us from complaining, envy, pride, dishonesty, wasted time, and worldliness. Let us be diligent in our work and eager in spirit, serving you as Lord. We pray for our neighbors and friends, that we and they might both be blessed in our friendship together. Bless the poor. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by W. T. G. Brown, B.A., B.D., Toronto, Canada.

quote: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, faith.
body: Heavenly Father, we turn to you in gratitude for your goodness, depending lovingly on your grace. You’re our shield, our strength, our guide — through Jesus Christ you forgive our sins, and we trust in you alone, since our own feeble strength offers no real security against temptation. We humbly ask for your sustaining grace today — let your companionship transform our daily work and turn our weakness into strength. Give us compassionate hearts for the sorrowing, tempted, and hopeless people whose lives will touch ours today, that we might follow our Savior in helpful service, letting his Spirit work through us to lead others to him. Let your Spirit help us stand firmly against everything that destroys souls, doing our part for the coming of your kingdom, faithful and true. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Robert E. Vinson, D.D., Austin, Texas.

quote: My tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and praise.
body: Heavenly Father, we rejoice in your love — knowing you love us drives out all our fear as we come to you in prayer. Your love has redeemed us, and moment by moment we’re kept by its power. That we might glorify you, and that the world might see we love you, help us be kind, courteous, and honest in every relationship, with the mind of Christ Jesus in us. Show us our duty as his followers, and help us see truth clearly and receive it gladly, doing your will in everything. Thank you for supplying all our needs — we’ve lacked nothing good, and we trust you confidently for the future, putting everything in your hands, knowing you’ll never fail us. Watch over our homes and loved ones today, and deliver us from all evil. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance.
body: Gracious and kind Heavenly Father, we lift our hearts to you at dawn, though we feel keenly how unworthy we are of your countless mercies, new every morning. We throw ourselves on your mercy — lay your protecting hand gently on our bowed heads, and though we hardly dare look up, let us hear your reassuring, forgiving voice. We gather here at the foot of your cross, knowing your great heart has room for us all. Wrap us in your everlasting arms, and carry us safely through today. As we head out into the rush of the world, stay near us — be our traveling companion, since we need your presence every moment. Thank you for the gift of your Son, who brought eternal calm to our hearts. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Make confession unto him.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for keeping watch over us through the night — we lay down and slept, and woke because you sustained us. You’ve opened the gate to this new day, setting fresh opportunities before us. As we head into new duties, we ask you to go with us — strengthen our weakness, guide our ignorance, and move us both to want and to do what pleases you. Help us offer our lives as a living sacrifice, fully acceptable to you, which is the least we owe you. We entrust to you all our loved ones, asking that your Spirit guide their hearts so they never forget you or neglect your claim on their lives. Remember those in authority over us, and put a healthy respect for you in their hearts, that they might govern faithfully. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He hath showed thee, O man, what is good... but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.
body: Almighty God, whom to truly know is eternal life, we come to you at the start of this day, wanting to know you as the Father of our spirits and refresh ourselves in your eternal goodness. As we draw near you in worship, draw near to us in blessing. Give us what you see we need — health, opportunity, and a willing mind that finds joy in good work. Give us the assurance of forgiven sin, so our labor isn’t shadowed by regret or shame. Give us the blessing of wider friendship — let us never think ourselves too good to mingle with the humble, or live apart from others’ hopes and sympathies, but find gladness in the shared life of all your children. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: They believed the scripture.
body: Father in heaven, we praise you for the grace that lets us see another day — your love is wondrous. We frail creatures bow for a moment to receive the blessing of your infinite care. We go out now to work and struggle, and we dare not go alone — temptation waits along our path, and danger may come suddenly for some of us. Be our friend. When today’s work is done, gather us at evening as an unbroken, happy family, unstained by sin. Bless the Church we love; let your Spirit stay with our pastor and all your people. We love our country — save it. For the whole world, we offer this humble prayer: let your kingdom come. Give us hearts that ache for others and hands ready to bless, pitying the homeless and protecting the weak. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Rev. David Otis Cowles, Jersey City, N.J.

quote: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
body: Heavenly Father, we bless you for your great gift to us, your children — provision for all our needs. Thank you for the power you’ve given people to bless and gladden one another through love’s warmth and friendship’s comfort, supporting each other in every good thing. Let us accept this great gift with a sense of responsibility — let the wealth of human love given to us never be wasted or taken for granted: the tender care of our early years, our parents’ love, our teachers’ patience, our counselors’ wisdom, all the sweet kindnesses of home. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Hugh Black, D.D., New York City.

quote: The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble.
body: Father, thank you for revealing your love through Jesus Christ, who’s brought inspiration, guidance, and hope into our lives. Thank you for the work you’ve given us, and for your presence and help as we take it up. Help us live in constant companionship with you, drawing life from your life, showing you to others through our ordinary dealings with them. Strengthen us quickly when the world’s pull grows strong, and when we’re tempted to value what fades over what lasts. Give us a deep hunger for righteousness, and help us be genuine in everything we do, say, and think. As your disciples, Christ, let us grow more like you each day. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: While ye have light, believe in the light.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, we come reverently to your mercy seat, honoring your holy name. Thank you for revealing yourself through your Word, through the beauty of nature, and through your Spirit in our hearts. We confess our unworthiness — we’ve sinned, forgetting your commands and your unchanging love. Father, forgive us for Christ’s sake. Thank you for our home and loved ones, and every comfort of life. Bless every member of our family, and stay with us in our home; and when our days on earth are numbered, let our hearts rejoice, assured that our Savior has prepared a place for us in his eternal home, where we’ll meet again the loved ones who’ve gone before us. May the glory of our salvation belong not to us, but to you, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, now and forever. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
body: Father, through another night you’ve kept us with the tender care a mother shows her infant — unaware of the world, we’ve still been with you. Though our eyes closed in darkness, you watched over us; though unconscious, as though in the land of death, you were mindful of us. You’ve protected us from unseen dangers and brought us from the shadowlands of sleep into the light of a new day — we thank you. And now, Father, this day is ours, your priceless gift. Help us love you today, do your will, and be patient, kind, and honest. Let us remember all day that everyone around us is your child, and show our love for you by helping them, staying clean in thought, word, and deed. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
body: 4:32 Heavenly Father, thank you for protection and sleep through the night, and for the blessing of a new day. Guide us through all its hours, giving us wisdom to understand and grace to do your will. In our dealings with each other and with everyone we meet, let us show the spirit of Christ. Bless the children, their friends and teachers, and teach them always to be fair and to love truth. Guard our absent loved ones, keeping their hearts pure and granting them health and prosperity as you see fit. Bless our neighbors, especially anyone facing sorrow, sickness, or hardship, that their faith wouldn’t fail, and that under your blessing they’d find better days ahead. We pray for everyone who’s given in to temptation or turned from Christ, that through repentance and faith you’d bring them to real salvation. Keep us humble. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Now abideth faith, hope, love.
body: Father in heaven, thank you for your wonderful love toward us — infinite, eternal, a love that won’t let us go. We love you, adore you, and praise you, yet we humbly admit we haven’t always loved you with our whole hearts, or loved our neighbors as ourselves. We’ve sinned and fallen short of your glory in many ways. Have mercy on us, and according to your abundant tender mercy, blot out our failures. Stay in our home today — let it be nothing less than God’s house and heaven’s gate. Send us to our daily work knowing we’re about our Father’s business, living and laboring as though we see the invisible God. Let us be Christlike in every dealing with others, at home, in society, and in business. Unify and purify your Church. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Commit thy way unto the Lord.
body: God, we come to you as children come to a father, asking for your loving care and protection. We don’t know what awaits us — joy or sorrow, life or death — and before entering this unknown future, we commit our way to you, remembering your promise to direct our paths. Thank you for the common blessings of life that come so quietly we almost forget them, and for the special blessings that show your personal care for us. Because of your promise of forgiveness, we ask your mercy for our sins, through Jesus Christ our Lord. Give us, moment by moment, both spiritual and material blessings, and help us trust you even when we don’t understand. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Jesus departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
body: God, our Father, as this new day begins, we look up to you, thankful for the night’s care and the joy of another morning. Today will bring its own blessings — help us see and seize them. We’ll have chances to be kind — let us remember that kind words never really fade. We’ll have chances to share someone’s burden — let us, like our great Burden-Bearer, enter tenderly into others’ needs. Joy may come, sorrow may fall, surprises may wait around some corner, but show us, ever-present Father, that nothing can happen to your children without your knowledge. Teach us to give thanks for our joys, to remember, in grief, that Jesus wept too, and to trust you with everything unexpected. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
body: Almighty God, our Father in heaven, God of our Lord Jesus Christ, we wait on you, asking your Spirit to enable our worship. We’re not worthy of your smallest mercy, yet you’ve enriched us with everything we need. Search us and show us our sins, and as we confess, trust you to forgive and cleanse us. Thank you for every blessing you’ve given, and trust you to give what’s best for us. Bless everyone dear to us, and if we have any enemies, bless them too, giving us right hearts toward them. If anyone we love is far from you, bring them to faith and repentance. Jesus is the true vine, and we, his disciples, are the branches — help us stay connected to him, so the Spirit’s fruit grows naturally from our lives. Send out laborers into your harvest. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: We trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men.
body: Our God and Father, thank you for your protecting care through the night, and for this new day, your free gift, with its message of renewal. Teach us again today the meaning of home, friendship, and the chance to work for you and for others. Point us in the right direction as we head into another day; fortify us against evil, and restrain any harmful tendency in us. If the way grows dark, help us see your light; if we feel lonely, remind us of your companionship. Help us add some joy to other lives today, so we can end it knowing we did something worthwhile, and as evening shadows fall, let us give thanks again and entrust ourselves to you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: As thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee.
body: Father in heaven, as children come to an earthly parent, we, your children, come to you. We acknowledge your goodness in keeping us safe through the night and renewing your mercy with the new day. While we slept, you let no harm come near us, and we woke this morning with fresh strength for the work ahead. As today brings new duties, equip us for them; as new temptations arise, strengthen us against them; in whatever battles we face, lead us to victory. Guard us against evil, and make us receptive to every good influence, so the wrong tendencies in us grow weaker and weaker, and love for you and everyone else becomes the settled character of our lives. Thank you for mercies renewed daily, and forgive all our sin. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: This is his commandment, that we believe.
body: Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. Thank you for the day ahead, with its opportunities, privileges, unexpected pleasures, and disappointments alike. We’re glad for the chance to serve you and witness for you in our dealings with others. Let us stay ready to show real interest in the wellbeing of everyone we meet, at home, on the train, in the street, at work. Looking back on our Lord’s life, we see that wherever he went, people felt hope rising in them, their spirits lifted, and they faced life with fresh courage. Let us, too, be used today by your Spirit to make Christ real to someone. Let us find real joy in the work we’re called to, seeking your will even in ordinary duties. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby.
body: Lord our God, we sincerely thank you for your never-failing love and mercy — for every earthly blessing, and especially for the gift of Jesus Christ, our Savior, we bless and praise your holy name. Cleanse our hearts from all wrongdoing, and forgive us wherever we’ve failed to do your will. Give us the strength we need to overcome temptation and to be brave. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Be not afraid, only believe.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for the right, like a child, to approach you with expectation. Humbly relying on your promises and the merit of your Son alone, we pray — in our sorrow, send the Comforter. In our helplessness, equip us for service; in our ignorance and loneliness, show us the path where you’ll walk with us. Live within us, so we sin no more against you, your will becoming our pleasure. Give us the courage of faith, the comfort of forgiveness, and the assurance that underneath us are the everlasting arms. Help us hold to what’s good and turn from what’s evil. Above all, giver of life, we pray not just for ourselves but for everyone, and especially for children, that you’d give them abundant, saving, healthy life. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord... to show forth thy loving kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night.
body: Loving Father in heaven, we come to you as the good God who cares for us here below, aware of our many needs but trusting that you can supply them all through Christ’s riches. Teach us also to recognize our weaknesses fully — “teach me to know how frail I am” — and despite all our limits, help us come to you like children to a trusted parent, confident you’ll guide our steps rightly. Bless our children, loving Savior, and as they grow, let them grow into the fullness of Christ. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Ye shall search for me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
body: — Jeremiah 29:13 You, in whom to dwell is the light of life, and from whom to depart is the shadow of death — give us the joy of your constant presence today, so there’s no darkness in us at all. We’re not children of darkness, Father, though our path today may lead through human sorrow, conflict, and sin — let us walk as people who belong to the light. Give us open, alert minds to discover your will, and a holy resolve to both love and do it. Help us be honest amid falsehood, pure where evil is common, kind to the friendless, and willing to carry others’ burdens for our Savior’s sake. Take away the guilt of our sin, and give us the joy of a victorious life through our Redeemer. At day’s end, bring us home with untroubled, unashamed spirits, to find rest and the peace beyond understanding. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: We will show forth thy praise.
body: We come before your throne, Lord, to praise your name and bring a large request. We claim the inheritance left us by our Elder Brother — his peace, which the world can’t give and can’t take away. We won’t ask for wealth, with its pull toward worldliness, nor for long life, with the weakness age can bring, nor for status among others, knowing self-honor is worthless, nor for freedom from sorrow, remembering that those who follow Christ will face hardship in this world — but we do ask, Father, to rest in perfect peace in you, trusting that the one who didn’t spare his own Son will freely give us everything else besides. Let the peace of God, beyond understanding, guard our hearts and minds through Christ our Redeemer. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise.
body: We thank you, Lord, for being our dwelling place through every generation — before the mountains were formed or the world was made, from everlasting to everlasting, you are God. Thank you that the Word became flesh and lived among us, full of grace and truth — that Christ took on human form and became obedient even to death on a cross, so we might have abundant life. Grant, Lord, that we, through your Spirit’s power, might grow like Christ in mind, heart, and will — true brothers and sisters to the whole human family, patient in service, ready to forgive as he forgave. We pray for every nation on earth, all made of one blood — hasten the coming of your kingdom, when nations no longer war against each other, and the knowledge of God covers the earth like water covers the sea. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: It is good to sing praises unto our God.
body: Father, you’ve taught us to call you by that name — thank you for bringing us into your family through living faith in Jesus Christ, your Son and our Elder Brother. Thank you for a Father’s love; keep us always within its circle. Thank you for your daily care and protection — go with us as we leave home, and return with us at evening to share our table and stay with us through the night, until morning breaks and shadows flee. Draw every member of our family into real fellowship with your Son, cleansed from sin and kept from falling by his power, presented one day faultless before you with great joy. Make us more tender and thoughtful toward each other and everyone around us. Forgive us all our failures. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for this new day, with its privileges and opportunities. In gratitude for your love and mercy, let us serve you today with sincere hearts. Give us grace to do your will and accept your purposes for us with joyful obedience, trusting your will is always best. Keep our hearts from sin, our minds pure, and our motives honest. Forgive us when we fail, and let us bring even the ordinary duties of today into your presence. Whether today brings gain or loss, sunshine or shadow, blessing or grief, let our faith stay steady. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
body: God our Father, you’ve watched over us through sleep, and under the shadow of your wings we’ve rested safely. Now that we’re awake, let us stay close to you — let us walk and work with you through every hour of the day, seeing you in everything around us, finding it our true nourishment to do the will of the one who sent us and finish his work. In the busiest moments, don’t let us lose sight of you or loosen our grip on what’s eternal. Defend us from every danger, but especially from our own faults and weaknesses. Help us pass through today casting no shadow on other lives, but bringing brightness into the world instead. And when the day ends, may we have the quiet joy of knowing we’ve lived out something of that eternal life found in doing justice, loving kindness, and walking humbly with God. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by William Pierson Merrill, D.D., New York.

quote: Praise the Lord, call upon his name.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, in whom we live and move and exist — every good and perfect gift comes from your kind hand, and we humbly thank you for all your loving kindness. We come confessing our sins and asking your forgiveness. Bless our bodies and spirits, which belong to you; give us the food, strength, clothing, and shelter we need, and the grace to know and do your will. Make the path of duty clear, and keep us from temptation and sin, so we can honor you on earth. Bless everyone we love, whom we bring before you in prayer — heal the sick, comfort the sorrowful, strengthen the faltering. Remember graciously the community we live in, prosper your Church here, and bless our country, making us a people whose God is truly the Lord. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit.
body: We come before you, our Father and God, to worship, praise your name, and thank you for your many blessings. We confess our sins, but we come boldly, since our trust is in Christ, our advocate and mediator. Show each of us your will for today, and help us do it without selfishness. Grant, Lord, that your will be done more and more among all people, and that Jesus wouldn’t just have a place in the throne room of our hearts, but sit fully on the throne there. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
body: 6:18 Heavenly Father, thank you for the rest our bodies found in sleep — through the long night you were watching over us, just as mindful of us by day as by night. Help us, dear Father, be as mindful of you as you are of us; don’t let us get so absorbed in worldly things that we have no time for you. As we talk with you, our sins rise like mountains, and we’re ashamed of our weakness — we confess everything and ask your forgiveness. Don’t leave us in shame, but take our hand and lift us up; give us the assurance of pardon, and help us live today the way Jesus lived every day. We pray for the discouraged, that you’d cheer them; for those in darkness, that you’d give them light; for those fighting themselves, each other, or you, that you’d give them peace. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
body: In your wisdom, whose ways are beyond understanding, you’ve appointed tears for our dear ones — calling them into a sorrow like Gethsemane, where loneliness and anguish wring their hearts. Grant, Father, that they might meet Jesus there — that’s all we know how to pray. Our clumsy words can’t comfort them, and our limited sight can’t grasp your purpose, but Father of love, draw these grieving ones close to yourself in the person of the sympathetic Savior. Through their tears, may they see Jesus — there’s no real comfort but in you. Be their companion in confusion, their strength in weakness, their courage for this new season of loss, showing them that all your plans for your children stretch across two worlds. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Ye are the salt of the earth... Ye are the light of the world.
body: Our Savior and our Intercessor, you came into the world not to be served, but to serve, and to give your life as a ransom for many — you went about doing good. Looking on the young man, you loved him; you wept over Jerusalem. In the spirit of that same love and sacrifice for lost souls, set our hearts on fire with a similar love for others. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him.
body: Help us, God, to recognize ourselves today as your children. Let us remember that we come from you, our true home, and mourn whatever glory of that origin we’ve forgotten in the busyness of earthly life. Let it be in our hearts to thank you, Lord, that something in each of us — some deep instinct, some first love — survives the weight of ordinary life like embers that never quite go out. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
body: God, our Father, we worship your name and bless you for who you are. We acknowledge you as the source and support of our lives — your creatures, never left to suffer eternal lack, never left without our daily bread. We’re your children, and we believe we come from you — let us never plead your fatherhood in vain, but stand as heirs of God through promise, not as strangers or orphans. Give us your Holy Spirit, that he might reveal Jesus Christ to us fully — let us know him, live in him, and let his words live in us, so that neither prosperity nor the world’s temptations pull our faith away from him. Forgive our sins, and cleanse our hearts, so we become a dwelling place for God through the Spirit, Christ in us and we in him. Guide us in our dealings with others, so our words carry life, and show us how to help bring your kingdom to earth. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
body: Father in heaven, look on us with infinite love and compassion. Live in us, so that shaped by your good Spirit, we might have real fellowship with you as your children. Help us trust you always; appoint for us whatever you will, and make us ready to receive gratefully whatever you send our way. Go with us in every task today. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us.
body: Heavenly Father, thank you for mercifully keeping us in health and strength, and filling our lives with so much comfort and happiness. We pray for everyone near and dear to us, asking you to keep and defend them from evil, enriching them with your Spirit. We also pray for all your followers everywhere, and that everyone still distant from you would come to know your goodness and want to follow you. As we pray, “Thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven,” let us daily strive, through our actions, to build up your kingdom here, and let our lives show everyone that we belong to you. Let us honor you by obeying your command to treat others as we’d want to be treated, so that others come to know you as their Lord and Savior. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Alba B. Johnson.

quote: I will therefore that men pray everywhere.
body: Father, we’re your children through faith in our Redeemer. We’re your children when we’re obedient and you’re pleased with us, and we’re your children too when we’re wayward and you correct us in grief. We know our sins displease you deeply, and they pain us too — for Jesus’ sake, forgive us. Accept our deep gratitude for your tender mercies throughout our past, for the promise of your grace for every need, and the assurance of your presence always. Bless us in the duties we’ve been called to. Deliver us from the fear of others’ opinions, and keep us from measuring our duty by what everyone else does, helping us instead to follow your standard. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Ask what I shall give thee.
body: Lord, our Father, we lift our hearts in love and gratitude to you. Your constant mercies come with the morning light and fall on us again with evening shadows — without them, we couldn’t live. The only thing we can give back to you is our love and praise; everything else we owe to others in need, just like our own. Help us understand that worshiping you benefits us most, lifting our minds and purifying our hearts in your presence. Let each day make you more real to us, until no other friend feels as close. Show us your will for us, so we’re not groping blindly but following your plan. While we’re grateful for every comfort we’re given, keep us from setting our hearts too firmly on things that fade. Help us know our own weaknesses, so we have sympathy for anyone who fails because they haven’t leaned on you. Let us live in a way that never spoils a day or wounds a heart through deeds or words we can’t take back. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: By faith Abraham... obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
body: Father in heaven, thank you for your presence in our hearts and our home, for your loving kindness and tender mercy. We want to give you the largest possible place in our lives, so your plans for us come true and we play our small part in your great design. We humbly ask you to forgive whatever hinders our fellowship with you or our usefulness to others, and to correct whatever in our character isn’t Christlike. Teach us to trust you for every need, of soul and body alike. Defend us in temptation, and help us remember we’re citizens of your spiritual kingdom. Bless all our fellow believers around the world. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He ever liveth to make intercession for them.
body: Almighty and everlasting God, because of your merciful hand over us, we’ve been kept safe through another night. Help us trust you, wanting nothing but your will, desiring only to be what you’d have us be. Show us how deep your pity is, how great your love, how boundless your goodness — let us feel that you’ve called us to a holy purpose, placed us here to do your will, and destined us to enjoy you forever. Breathe into us a spirit of prayer and teachability, and help us take your Word seriously. Thank you for Scripture, for the Church, and for salvation through Christ. We bless you for every gift, but above all for your indescribable gift, our Savior Jesus Christ — we rejoice knowing he’s interceding for us even now. Let the weary come to you and find rest, and send workers into your harvest. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Before they call, I will answer.
body: Lord our God, how excellent is your name in all the earth. We come acknowledging your goodness and greatness, bowing reverently in Jesus’ name to praise you and ask the strength we need for today’s duties. Most humbly, we confess our sins — in thought, word, and deed we’ve broken your holy law and grieved your Spirit of grace. We recognize our weakness and failure — when we want to do good, evil is always close at hand. We’ve brought shame on your name, led astray by the pull of sin around us. But in your infinite love, you won’t refuse to hear our prayer. Forgive our many sins, and make possible a deeper work of grace in our lives. Help us stay true to you every day, remembering your mercy and acknowledging you always. Strengthen us for the hour of trial, and bring back anyone who’s wandered from you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee.
body: 48:17 God and Father of every family on earth, you deserve our daily love and constant gratitude. You know we’re always children crying out to you for food, shelter, and protection. We reach toward you to be led through paths we can’t foresee, past hidden temptations and traps — deliver us from evil. Help us cherish our family relationships, established and blessed by you. Let our home be kept in peace and goodwill, held together by a love that drives out suspicion and fear. We devote it, and all its concerns, to your care, so that our hearts’ longing for your approval and presence brings us contentment with godliness. Today, in family worship, we confess our sins, trusting the faithful one to forgive and cleanse us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
body: Dear Heavenly Father, thank you for the rest and safety of another night, and the light of another day. You’re the giver of every good and perfect gift — thank you for preserved health, continued life, and another day’s opportunity to serve. Give us stronger faith, so we go through each day relying only on your strength and guidance. Keep us from temptation and sin, and let us accomplish some good during the hours of light, so that at day’s end we find some victories won and some real growth in our spiritual life. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: We all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory.
body: Loving Lord, renew in us the image of our Creator. Through sin, we’ve marred and lost the holiness that makes us like you. Transform us into the likeness of your Son, the exact image of the Father, who came, died, and rose again so we could be remade in God’s likeness. Show us yourself through your Word, so that, reflecting your glory like a mirror, we’re changed more and more into that same image. Let the light of Christ’s love shine through us as we move among others each day. Make us so like him that people see him in us and are drawn to him, so we can truly say, “To live is Christ.” Deepen in us the longing to see his unveiled face one day, satisfied at last, awake in his likeness. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: My grace is sufficient for thee.
body: Heavenly Father, we, your children, bless you for the dawn of this new day, your gift to us. Help us use it wisely, living through its hours in a way that proves us worthy of such a gift, doing something worthwhile so that at day’s end we feel we haven’t lived it in vain. For every difficulty, give us sufficient grace; for every decision, give us wisdom; for every temptation, give us the power to overcome. Keep us aware all day of your companionship and of unseen realities — let us grow in the knowledge that matters most, understanding more fully what we now only partly grasp. Reveal your will more clearly, and let this day see it better fulfilled in us. We pray for everyone bound to us by family and love. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.
body: Father, thank you for revealing yourself to us in Jesus Christ our Lord, and for your kind care over us. We ask that your Spirit lead us into the light of truth. Give us a larger vision of your glory, and make us more faithful to you and to others’ needs. Teach us to pray. Give us deeper faith and love, and clearer vision to see the deeper meaning of your truth. Bless our country and your Church everywhere. Bless the young, the old, the sick, and the troubled. Fill our hearts with sympathy and hope, and let us live to serve you and everyone around us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
body: Father, we bring our home and hearts to you today for the blessing you’ve planned for them. Let nothing in us hinder your coming, cloud our vision of you, or muffle your voice. Open our ears and eyes to hear and see you; open our whole souls so you can enter. Come in, Father of us all, into our home and our hearts. We need many things today, but the one thing, best of all, is you yourself — having you, we have everything. Bless our home with your presence, and the sun will shine even through the darkest clouds; bless our hearts with your love, and no burden will be too heavy to carry for you. And from a home where you live, let us carry you out into our lives, blessing everyone we meet. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just... think on these things.
body: Father, thank you for watching over us while we slept. Now guard and guide us through today — let your presence stay with us, and as our day is, so let our strength be. Let your love fill our hearts and show in our actions; help us resist evil, endure trial, overcome difficulty, and do your will in everything, working with all our might at whatever we’re given to do. Keep us from discouragement — let your joy be our strength, and let us not grow weary in doing good. Let your Word light our path and guide our steps. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Forgive, and ye shall be forgiven.
body: Heavenly Father, we pause at the threshold of this new day to be with you a moment. Refresh us with a fresh vision of your face; tell us your will, so we can do it. Fill the whole day with cheer through your presence. Thank you for life and work in such a beautiful world. Give us a real sense of your countless mercies, so our hearts stay grateful, and we show your praise not just with our lips but with our lives. Perfect us in love, so we overcome selfishness and learn to forgive as freely as we ask forgiveness. Let our home life be made holy today, and every day, by your presence as our unseen guest. As we go out among people, doing our work, make us true friends to everyone, representing you well — give our activities today a higher purpose, and show us how to fill it with meaningful service, so that night brings real peace. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Hitherto hath the Lord helped us.
body: Lord, Creator and generous provider, in whom we live and move and exist, we adore you for your loving kindness and tender mercy. With shame, we confess our many sins — our lives fall short of your standard, and we’ve wandered from the right path. Father, look on us in mercy, and have pity on our sin. Look on your Son, who died for us, and for his sake accept us as righteous before you. Let our sins not only be erased from your record, but let the Spirit’s power help us truly die to sin and live for righteousness. Comfort the discouraged, cheer the sad, befriend the friendless, teach the ignorant, and hasten the day when truth prevails and your kingdom comes. We trust it all to you — as our Shepherd, lead us today, and as our King, defend us from every threat. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
body: We thank you, Lord, for the holy Sabbath, so full of blessing for your children. We honor you for this memorial of our redemption and this glimpse of the rest that awaits your people. Help us keep the day holy — bless us richly in reading your Word, hearing the gospel, and every part of this holy day’s worship. Be with every minister of the gospel, especially those preaching today. Bless our children, at home and in Sunday school, and give their teachers the ability to shape character and guide young lives rightly. Comfort everyone grieving, especially those unable to attend worship today. Give us grace not just to hear your Word, but to help spread its light throughout the world, drawing us closer to you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer.
body: You who are so vast our thoughts can’t contain you, yet so near we often overlook you — hear our prayer. Our Savior taught us to call you by the intimate names of home; we can call ourselves your children, and you our Father and Friend. We’re never as unimportant as we sometimes feel — if we’re smaller than a child in your sight, your care for us is greater than a mother’s. Just as gardeners walk through their gardens in spring to see how things are growing, let us walk through our own souls to see what’s taking root there — may we find love, hope, courage, and every other richness of your grace. We promise, not as a passing wish but as a real commitment, to nurture the good and root out the weeds. Bless our country with strength for what’s right, and our homes with children who grow into people of integrity. Forgive us for caring more about temporary things than eternal ones. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Pray now unto the Lord our God.
body: We thank you, Heavenly Father, for your care through the past night, and for the Bible — help us understand it, believe it, obey it, and love it. Thank you, blessed Savior, that you came from heaven to earth so we could go from earth to heaven, that you died so we could live. Thank you that you rose from the dead and ascended, and that you’re always interceding for us. Thank you for saying, “Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.” We come to you now — have mercy on us. We’ve done wrong; forgive us. We want to do right; help us. We’re sinners; be our Savior. Fill us with your Spirit, and devote us to your service. Comfort the troubled, guide the confused, strengthen the weak, and help the tempted. Bless our country, your Church everywhere, and every Christian worker. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Watch and pray.
body: God, Lord of heaven and earth, builder of the universe, the rock of our salvation, unchanging in holiness and love — we lift our hearts to you, knowing you care for us and hear us. Lord Jesus, Son of God and Son of Man, you came and shared our life, teaching, healing, and dying on the cross as our sin-bearer, triumphing over evil and promising to return in glory. Bless everyone dear to us; lead them in the way everlasting, and stand with us all through suffering, sorrow, and worry. Thank you for the gospel and for the Bible, the record of what you’ve said and done, and what you’ve promised for the future — let it be our guide to life, our key to history, and our source of hope. Help us do our part in spreading its message throughout the world. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He shall save them because they trust in him.
body: Father, as your children, we hope for your presence in this new day, and listen for your voice. Make us sensitive to your touch and alert to your word, eager to know your will and resolute to do it — knowing you closely is our deepest need. In you is food for every hunger, light for every gloom, purpose for all our energy, and love strong enough to burn away our selfishness — this is our faith; make it our lived experience. Look with pity on all humanity; end conflict, establish justice among nations, help rulers govern rightly, and let reason and love bind human hearts together. Be enough for us all day; be our defense against evil, keep us steady under temptation, refresh us when our resolve weakens, and keep us kind, unselfishly and eagerly, all day long. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus, who... humbled himself, and became obedient unto death.
body: Our prayer, Father, is in the name of your Son, who forgave our sins on the cross. Help us, by your Spirit, separate ourselves from sin and step into the inheritance of your redeemed children. Let us give the world more in spiritual blessing today than we take in material gain, understanding that our safety of soul and body rests in you alone. Give us real love for all humanity and a genuine desire for everyone’s salvation. Let us be a real help to someone today, and let people see more of Christ in us than of ourselves. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: If a man love me, he will keep my words.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, thank you for your goodness and loving kindness to us and to everyone — for health that gives strength and sickness that teaches patience, and most of all for the forgiveness of sins through Christ, for the means of grace, and the hope of glory. Guide us in what we ought to do and the path we ought to walk, and give us the grace to walk it well. Save us from being so busy we forget you, or so comfortable we feel no need of you. Fill our hearts with grateful love for your Son, our Savior and King, and open our eyes to the light and our souls to your Spirit’s grace, so he can come in and work in us. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
body: Most gracious Father, source of every good gift, give us the one thing we need above all — your Holy Spirit, to help our weakness, so our worship is purged of anything false. We long to pray sincerely, but can’t unless you clear our hearts of empty desire. Free us from selfishness in prayer, and from asking only for what serves our earthly comfort. You must inspire the requests only you can answer. We’re aware of our sinfulness, but can’t feel real sorrow until you move us to honest repentance. We’d be grateful for your countless mercies, but our cold hearts aren’t ready to praise you until you awaken genuine gratitude in us. Our love fades unless your Spirit fans it back into flame. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: With my spirit within me will I seek thee early.
body: Father in heaven, we call to you because we’ve called before and you heard us. Come to us, Lord, when everything is dark and trouble weighs us down — lift us up again, so we can praise you and find joy in our hearts. For today’s work, give us free grace; for the hard road, the resolve to keep going; for the hour that discourages us, calm us and lift us back up. Make us gentle, Lord, with our loved ones — never let us give way to harsh words or unfair thoughts. Lord Jesus, hear our prayer as we confess our sins at the foot of your cross; let our sins fade and our hearts find new joy. Help us accept your will, whatever we must give up. Gather this little family close to you the way a bird shelters its young from a storm. Cover us with your love, and protect us in the palm of your hand. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith.
body: Almighty God, our Heavenly Father, giver of every good thing, in whom we live and move and exist, who has brought us safely to see another day’s light — we, your humble servants, offer heartfelt praise for keeping us safe throughout our lives, especially through the night, and for this day’s rest and opportunity. Thank you for every mercy — home, friends, health, strength, and every blessing crowning our lives. Give us grace today, in every thought, word, and deed, to honor your name and brighten the lives around us, helping others toward better things. Help us do wholeheartedly whatever we’re given to do for you and for others. Keep sin and evil far from us, and if it pleases you, spare us sickness, sorrow, and worry — but whatever you have in store, let it draw us nearer to you. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: He shall save the children of the needy.
body: Lord, our Heavenly Father, we praise your holy name for all your loving kindness and tender mercy — you’ve opened your hand and supplied all our needs. Thank you that while we were still weak, Christ died for us in due time, ransoming our souls from sin and death and giving us eternal life. Grant, Lord, that each of us here would receive Christ Jesus as our eternal Savior. We praise you for the gift of your Holy Spirit, living in our hearts and revealing Christ to us day by day. Bless every member of this household and everyone we love, wherever they are right now — we’re grateful that in Jesus’ keeping, we and they are safe. Remember with mercy anyone in distress today, in mind, body, or circumstance, and comfort everyone mourning. Let the whole earth turn back to you, God, and every nation worship you in spirit and truth. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: I will magnify him with thanksgiving.
body: God of mercy, Savior and Sanctifier of all — we worship you, the triune God, calling on our whole souls to praise your holy name. We confess our sins, but rejoice that they’re constantly washed away by the blood of Christ, and because he’s righteous, we, hidden in him, are counted righteous too. We come to your mercy seat with joy and thanksgiving, counting our countless blessings, knowing that no good thing is withheld from those who love and trust you. As you’ve delivered us from every danger and sorrow in the past, we’re confident you’ll keep whatever we entrust to you for the future. Enrich our hearts with your Word, so we live clean, holy lives and have the power to win others to Christ. We pray for your rich grace on our loved ones, at home and elsewhere, and for the sin-troubled world, that your kingdom would come and your will be done, through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by J. H. Jefferis.

quote: I have loved thee with an everlasting love.
body: Father in heaven, we praise and honor your holy name. Your love watches over us, protecting us from every danger and providing for every need — you never fail us, and we trust in you. We’ve sinned against you in thought, word, and deed, but we come with humble hearts, confessing our unworthiness and asking your forgiveness through the merit of Christ’s shed blood. Thank you for every good gift you’ve given — accept us, and use us as you see fit. Bless each of us as we need blessing, and with us, bless everyone sick, sorrowing, discouraged, or struggling with sin. We pray too for everyone working, in small ways or great, to extend your kingdom in people’s hearts everywhere. Be with us in our daily work, material and spiritual, that we might be workers you’re not ashamed of. Gather us home eventually, with none missing. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: They that trust in the Lord shall be as Mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
body: Gracious Heavenly Father, thank you for this morning’s light. Fill our hearts with gratitude and love for the blessings of the past week, and direct our conduct through the week ahead, so that everything we do pleases you. Let our service to you bring not only our own joy and comfort, but let our example lead others to love and serve you too. Help us realize every day that we owe everything to you, and that every good thing in life flows from your mercy and kindness. We ask this for Christ’s sake. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: His ears are open unto their prayers.
body: Gathered at this family altar, God, we come to seek your face. Keep us today sheltered in the light of your presence; help us do only what pleases you, aware at every step that you’re with us. We ask your very best, both for ourselves and for our loved ones absent from this prayer today. As parents, let us guide our household well; as children, let us live worthy of the Lord in every way. Amid life’s darkening shadows, keep us walking in the light, our hearts guarded by peace. Fill us with the knowledge of your will, and make us fruitful in every good word and deed. As we gather here, Lord, help us grasp the power of your death, the strength of your ongoing life, and the blessed hope of your return. We ask your presence through today — we don’t dare walk alone, since temptation is subtle and the world’s pull is strong. Lead us, Lord, in your steps. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy... For unto you is born this day... a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
body: We’re filled with joy and gratitude this morning for the gift of the Savior, Jesus. We’re especially grateful that he isn’t a distant Savior, but one joined to our humanity through his birth, his childhood, his humility, his love. Born among farm animals when he first took on human form, he’s lifted from us the weight of sin and worry — in him, we’re glad. With the angels who sang at his birth, we add our own voice of joy; with the shepherds who wondered what it all meant, we still search to understand the mystery of his coming. Give joy today to everyone, we sincerely pray. Bless every child; be with the poor, and give all of us, and everyone else, a spirit of goodwill and generosity. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: We have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
body: Father, seated on your high and glorious throne, help us feel this morning that you’re never far from any of us. You’ve shown us your nearness in Jesus Christ our Lord — help us see that only our own selfishness can separate us from you. Take every selfish impulse out of our hearts, and fill them with holy love for you, so that Jesus’ promise comes true for us: that you, our Father, and he, our Brother, come and live with us today. Speak to us in your still, small voice. Christmas has come and gone — we’ve given and received tokens of love, and though we can’t repeat those gifts every day, we sincerely ask that the Christmas spirit stay alive in our hearts and in everyone’s hearts everywhere. Clear out every trace of jealousy or resentment toward anyone, and give us Christ’s own attitude toward all humanity. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
body: Lord, whose eye sees everything, even the secrets of our hearts, and with whom is all wisdom and power — don’t stay silent to our prayer. In our suffering, let us sense your presence, and teach us submission through our pain. We can’t always understand what you’re doing with us, but Watcher of humanity, let our souls know you’re always just and good, endlessly patient in mercy. Give us your strength to bear our burdens. Teach us that to be truly useful to you, we must sometimes be wounded and broken — then we’ll come through like gold refined in fire, clothed in your righteousness, crowned with your glory. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer by Peter Ainslie, D.D., Baltimore.

quote: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father... Thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory.
body: Heavenly Father, for everything you’ve given and everything you’ve forgiven, we thank you. For every gift of nature, your kind providence, and your great salvation through Christ, we thank you. For blessings within us and around us, for everything that’s drawn us closer to you throughout our lives and our family’s lives, for our capacity to understand, love, build a home, and share friendship, for the good hope we hold for loved ones who’ve passed on, and for our own expectation of sharing heaven’s joy with them through Christ — we thank you. Help us live and work with a grateful, cheerful spirit, overcoming every trouble with patient hope and loving wisdom, sharing fellowship with everyone who follows Christ, near and far. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The love of Christ constraineth us.
body: Father in heaven, we’re your children, redeemed by Christ our Savior and Elder Brother, and we come to you in his name. Forgive our sins; free us from sin’s guilt, power, and consequences, and take the love of it out of our hearts. Let our love for you burn brightly, burning away every trace of evil, moving us constantly toward kind acts of service done for others in the Master’s name. Give us a clear vision of our ever-present Savior as a constant friend, and let that vision transform us, so we grow daily more like him in our desires, our words, and our actions. Bless everyone else with us, supplying every need and giving grace and guidance. Let the gospel’s light shine brightly in every land, bringing peace and drawing everyone to Christ and to each other in Christian unity. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
body: God, our Father, we’re about to enter a new day. Our desire is to meet its duties well, resist every distraction and temptation firmly, be ready for whatever danger or crisis might come, and arrive at evening pure and holy. We want to be a friend to everyone — strength for the weak, hope for the discouraged, joy for the sorrowing, power for the tempted. So we wait, Father, for your Spirit to come upon us before we step into whatever today holds. In this quiet early hour, bowed before you, our souls wait — touch us with the same hand that’s blessed others before us, speak to us in that still, small voice, and fill us with your own righteousness. Give us yourself, so we live rightly today, both for our own sake and before others. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.

quote: We love him, because he first loved us.
body: God of light, whose power drove back the darkness of primeval chaos — let the Sun of Righteousness so light up our dark hearts that we step into today’s duties with joyful faith, glad obedience, and a clear view of truth and duty. God of liberty, who gave us, once bound, the profound gift of free will — help us feel the weight of that responsibility. Perfect in us the practice of self-denial and the choosing of what’s better, until we learn, through experience as well as revelation, that serving you is the only true freedom the human soul can know. God of love, who has loved us, flawed as we are, with an everlasting love — help us reflect that love more and more, showing our growing affection through more loyal devotion, more faithful service, and fuller obedience, as we close this year in your hands and step into the next. Amen.
attribution: adapted from a prayer submitted from a contributor to the collection.
